name: Joy Division

whyMatters.en: Salford/Manchester post-punk four-piece; Unknown Pleasures (1979) and Closer (1980) fixed cold bass-led songs and Martin Hannett production before Curtis’s death ended the band.
whyMatters.zh: 索尔福德/曼彻斯特后朋克四人组；Unknown Pleasures（1979）与 Closer（1980）在 Curtis 去世结束乐队前，定下冷贝斯主导歌曲与 Martin Hannett 制作。

note.en: Melodic single with Hook bass hook.
note.zh: 带 Hook 贝斯钩子的旋律单曲。

interviewQuotes.text: I used to think of myself as an artist.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ian Curtis

lyricQuotes: Love will tear us apart again

shortBio.en: Curtis / Sumner / Hook / Morris post-punk; Love Will Tear Us Apart is the mass single.
shortBio.zh: Curtis / Sumner / Hook / Morris 后朋克；Love Will Tear Us Apart 是大众单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1976 (Warsaw). Factory Records albums with Hannett: spacious drums, Hook’s high melodic bass, Sumner’s brittle guitar, Curtis’s baritone.

Transmission, Atmosphere, Love Will Tear Us Apart (1980) are the entry set. Survivors continue as New Order—same bloodline, different tools.
body.zh:
1976 年组建（曾用名 Warsaw）。与 Hannett 的 Factory 专辑：宽鼓组、Hook 高音旋律贝斯、Sumner 脆吉他、Curtis 男中音。

Transmission、Atmosphere、Love Will Tear Us Apart（1980）是入口组。幸存者续为 New Order——同一血脉，不同工具。

title.en: Post-punk bass and space as method
title.zh: 后朋克贝斯与空间作为方法

body.en:
Joy Division matter for arrangement: bass often above guitar, drums gated/spaciously produced, vocal deadpan. Short catalog, high citation in goth/post-punk/indie.

Ended 1980; influence is structural.
body.zh:
Joy Division 要紧在编曲：贝斯常高于吉他、鼓经门限/宽空间制作、人声冷脸。目录短，哥特/后朋克/indie 引用高。

1980 年结束；影响是结构层面的。

title.en: Love Will Tear Us Apart: melodic single
title.zh: Love Will Tear Us Apart：旋律单曲

body.en:
Hook bass hook, Curtis vocal, danceable mid-tempo—widest public entry beyond the albums’ frost.

Posthumous chart life is part of the document.
body.zh:
Hook 贝斯钩子、Curtis 人声、可跳的中速——超越专辑冷感的最宽公众入口。

身后上榜属文献的一部分。

body.en:
Hannett space, synth pads, Curtis vocal further back—ballad form inside post-punk.

Teaching track for production as emotion carrier.
body.zh:
Hannett 空间、合成器铺底、Curtis 人声更靠后——后朋克里的谣曲形式。

制作作为情绪载体的教材曲。

title.zh: Factory 方法 → New Order 工具

body.en:
Same players adopt sequencers and club bass after 1980. JD’s DNA is the melodic bass + dry vocal template many revival bands copy.

Continuity is personnel, not costume.
body.zh:
同一批乐手在 1980 年后采用音序器与俱乐部贝斯。JD 的 DNA 是旋律贝斯 + 干人声模板，许多复兴乐队照抄。

连续的是人事，不是戏服。

title.en: Sparse public speech, dense myth later
title.zh: 公开话语 sparce，事后神话变密

body.en:
Contemporary quotes are limited; later oral history fills gaps. Prefer musical description over romantic fatalism.

Records first.
body.zh:
同时代引语有限；后来口述史填空。宁取音乐描述，不取浪漫宿命论。

唱片优先。

note.en: Space, bass, and restraint become a whole aesthetic.
note.zh: 空间、贝斯与克制自成美学。
